Name: Hurricane
Effect: Accuracy -2. Wind Move. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather removes the Accuracy penalty. Sunny Weather increases to Accuracy -4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
Description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.
